Match keys for finding duplicate people and companies.

- `name_match_key(v)`: "Last, First" reordered; accents, case, punctuation, titles (Dr, Mrs) and suffixes (Jr, III) removed; common nicknames expanded, so "Dr. Bob O'Neil Jr." and "Robert ONeil" both give "robert oneil"
- `website_match_key(v)`: the registrable domain of a website or email address ("shop.acme.co.uk" gives "acme.co.uk")
- `phone_display(v, default_cc)`: phone numbers formatted for people to read

68 functions in all. Every test case passes with the Rhai engine on GitHub and in a Neblex Code step.
